title: Protection from Above
coreMove: Convert authority into visible cover by absorbing the first risk before asking exposed people to be brave.
sourcePressure: Uses the Johnny Bravo rescue frame to define leadership as cover from above: power becomes useful when it moves toward exposed people, with empathy making their danger real enough to act on.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating safety as praise, niceness, or removing standards instead of spending authority to reduce avoidable fear.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.domain: air ambulance dispatch in coastal fog
exampleSpecs.audience: flight nurse coordinating a risky pickup
exampleSpecs.stakes: a stranded patient waits while weather closes in
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the nurse tells dispatch to put her name on the go call before asking the junior medic to board
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a blinking weather radar beside a sealed trauma kit

exampleSpecs.audience: control-room lead with a new operator
exampleSpecs.stakes: a pressure alarm may expose the trainee to blame
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the lead steps to the console, takes the radio call himself, then lets the trainee read the gauge aloud
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red pressure light reflected in safety glass

exampleSpecs.stakes: a dropped sandbag could end the production and shame the volunteer
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the stage manager announces the rigging check as her call before asking what the volunteer noticed
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a sandbag hanging over taped stage marks

exampleSpecs.audience: crew boss with rookies on a wind shift
exampleSpecs.stakes: a crew may be sent into a dangerous slope
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the boss moves his own crew tag off the safe ridge first to show he will take the exposed flank
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a laminated fire map held down by a compass

exampleSpecs.audience: charge nurse after a medication near miss
exampleSpecs.stakes: a junior nurse may hide future errors
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the charge nurse says the huddle starts with her missed double-check and points to the barcode scanner she ignored
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a barcode scanner lying beside an incident form

exampleSpecs.stakes: food loss and late-night blame threaten trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the owner puts on gloves and starts hauling spoiled boxes before assigning cleanup rows
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a frost-fogged freezer door propped open by a crate

skillTargets: identify exposed people before issuing direction
choose a leader action that makes early truth safer
judge whether safety preserves standards or erases them

tryThisNowSpec: Before the next correction or escalation, name who is most exposed and write the first heat you can absorb before you ask them to act.

sourceAnchors.name: Johnny Bravo
sourceAnchors.detail: the package text ties his descent through clouds and enemy fire to the idea of protection from above
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Johnny Bravo has altitude and options, and the whole lesson turns on what he does with that advantage when men below him are exposed.
